# Nazarii Klymok

> Nazarii Klymok (Ukrainian: Назарій Климок, Japanese: ナザリー・クリモク) is an Engineering Lead at BotsCrew in Lviv, Ukraine. He leads engineering teams that build production AI agents for enterprise clients.

Everything below is also on https://nazarii.dev. When this file and the site disagree, the site is current.

## Work

- Leads engineering teams that build production AI agents for enterprise clients. The agents work with a company's own data and systems, and people use them every day.
- Inside BotsCrew he pushes AI adoption across engineering, writes the SOPs the delivery teams work by, and keeps raising the bar on quality.
- BotsCrew (https://botscrew.com) is an AI transformation company and part of the CourtAvenue collective. BotsCrew is a Select partner in the Claude Partner Network.
- Studied computer science at Lviv Polytechnic National University.

## Outside work

- Plays drums in Honey Jam, a band from Lviv (https://www.instagram.com/honey_jam.lviv/). He started in 2024. They have played one gig so far, on Make Music Day at Black Honey café.
- Plays guitar and has written a couple of songs.
- Studies Japanese with a tutor and is sitting the JLPT N4 in December 2026.
- At 16 he spent a year in New Hampshire, USA, on the FLEX exchange program, and saw more than 25 states on road trips.
- Ran the full Frankivsk half marathon (21.1 km) in 2024 and finished mid-pack.
- Used to write Новочасний, a Ukrainian Telegram channel about the tech industry (https://t.me/novochasnyi). It is on a break.
